 HONOR Philippines 11.11 Sale Features ₱1,111 Smartphone Deal
 By Wazzup.PH - November 5, 2026 0 71 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 Get exciting discounts, freebies, and flexible payment options across Lazada, Shopee, and TikTok Shop. 
 Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines is getting a head start on the holiday shopping season with its 11.11 Early Mega Christmas Sale , offering exciting discounts, exclusive deals, and special freebies across Lazada, Shopee, and TikTok Shop from November 3 to 13, 2026 .
 Taking center stage is an exclusive offer on the HONOR Play 10 for just ₱1,111 , available on Lazada starting at 12 midnight on November 11, while supplies last. Shoppers can also enjoy discounts of up to ₱30,000 on select HONOR devices , along with limited-time promotions and exciting freebies throughout the campaign.
 More Deals Across Your Favorite Shopping Platforms
 Each shopping platform brings its own lineup of exclusive offers, giving HONOR fans more opportunities to score their favorite devices at attractive prices.
 On Lazada , shoppers can take advantage of the highly anticipated midnight deal, featuring the HONOR Play 10 for only ₱1,111 on November 11 . Customers can also enjoy up to 24 months of 0% interest installment when purchasing the HONOR Magic V6 using participating bank credit cards.
 Over on Shopee , shoppers can join the exciting “Watch the CEO’s New Jowa and Win an HONOR 600S” campaign for a chance to take home an HONOR 600S. The platform will also welcome the exclusive arrival of the HONOR Play 20A , accompanied by special shopping deals.
 Meanwhile, TikTok Shop is offering shoppers early access to the HONOR Pad X7b , with discounts of up to ₱2,000 . Customers can also look forward to special freebies bundled with selected devices, including the HONOR 600S and HONOR Pad X9b Max.
 More Flexible Ways to Shop
 Making holiday shopping even more convenient, HONOR Philippines is offering flexible payment options through participating credit card partners and Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) services, including SPayLater, LazPayLater, and TikTok PayLater .
 Eligible purchases may qualify for up to 24 months of 0% interest installment through major credit card partners, as well as up to six months of 0% interest through participating PayLater services. These options allow shoppers to manage their holiday purchases more conveniently while enjoying the latest HONOR devices. Terms and conditions apply.
 Across Lazada, Shopee, and TikTok Shop, customers can explore special deals on a wide selection of HONOR products, including the HONOR Play 10, HONOR Play 20A, HONOR Pad X7b, HONOR Pad X9b Max, HONOR 600S, and HONOR Magic V6 .
 The promotions also cover selected accessories and wearables, such as the HONOR Choice Earbuds Clip, HONOR Watch 6, and HONOR Choice Pencil , giving shoppers even more options for their holiday shopping lists.
 Don’t miss out on the HONOR 11.11 Early Mega Christmas Sale ! Shop through HONOR Philippines’ official stores on the following platforms:
 Lazada 
 Shopee 
 TikTok Shop 
 For more information, visit HONOR Philippines’ official website and follow its social media channels on Facebook , Instagram , and TikTok for the latest product announcements, promotional updates, and exclusive offers.
